notes: Native-green focused IEEE 1516.2-2025 reference-data attribute and representation witness. Public Create accepts a consumer module whose inherited referenced attribute and matching representation are supplied by a later adapter FOM, exposes that attribute through joined lookup, rejects separate schema-valid missing-attribute and mismatched-representation modules as InconsistentFOM, and permits valid federation-name reuse. Clauses 6.2.17, 4.14.9, and 4.5.2 are mapped directly. Broader table constraints, Java provider runtime, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
